headline: 40 ) -- Obama at Ohio campaign rally blames Trump's Iran war for higher prices, defends his 2015 diplomacy, says Iran now'
dek: Obama criticised Trump's war on Iran as the reason the price of just about everything is up, arguing his 2015 deal kept Iran from nuclear weapons through diplomacy without firing a missile, and that Iran now has veto power over the Strait of Hormuz, where oil goes to the world market, driving up…
sources: Former US President Barack Obama, campaign rally in Ohio, via Al Jazeera liveblog
fault_line: Is the Iran war a pocketbook issue -- Obama says it is why everything costs more -- or a security necessity whose price is worth paying?

sections.what_happened: Obama criticised Trump's war on Iran as the reason the price of just about everything is up, arguing his 2015 deal kept Iran from nuclear weapons through diplomacy without firing a missile, and that Iran now has veto power over the Strait of Hormuz, where oil goes to the world market, driving up oil, diesel and broader prices. AJ context in the entry: under the 2015 Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action Iran restricted enrichment and accepted inspections in exchange for sanctions relief; Trump withdrew from the JCPOA in 2018 in his first term. Demand evidence for this supplement: the Ohio clip is circulating on social platforms with polarized engagement around the Hormuz-leverage claim (sweep file /tmp/zeitgeist-4353a656-77dc-46a8-a12d-828dcbbfa0f6.xml).
sections.what_verified: 1 distinct publisher family: Al Jazeera (T2, STATE QA) for this speech report. The JCPOA history in the entry is standard public record; the price-attribution claim is not independently verified in-window.
sections.what_disputed: Campaign-rally context: Obama is campaigning for Democrats ahead of the Nov 3 midterms, so the speech is partisan advocacy, not a neutral assessment. The price-attribution claim (war as the reason for higher prices across the board) is asserted without figures in the entry; oil prices have multiple drivers (recorded Brent context: settled $116.72 Oct 24, +10% in October). Trump's stated rationale for the war is preventing a future Iranian nuclear weapon, not price effects.
sections.why_matters: Obama just turned the Iran war into a pocketbook attack: the war, he says, is why oil, diesel and just about everything costs more -- and Iran now holds the Hormuz lever he says his deal took away.
sections.context: Background: SUPPLEMENT from AJ Oct 25 liveblog read (00:40 GMT = 04:40 ) -- Obama at Ohio campaign rally blames Trump's Iran war for higher prices, defends his 2015 diplomacy, says Iran now holds Hormuz leverage

totw_analysis: Our read: Obama just turned the Iran war into a pocketbook attack: the war, he says, is why oil, diesel and just about everything costs more -- and Iran now holds the Hormuz lever he says his deal took away. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is the Iran war a pocketbook issue -- Obama says it is why everything costs more -- or a security necessity whose price is worth paying?
